lines.en: My hooves sink into the snow
I walk the frozen ground
Frost hangs from my antlers
I cross the tundra step by step
I move south along the treeline

lines.zh: 我的鼻息在冷空气里白
lines.en: My breath turns white in the cold
I pass frost-covered needles
I break a skin of ice
I cross the snow slope slowly
My prints trail out behind me
I push the snow aside
I lead the herd forward
I tramp a path through the snow
I lower myself going downhill
I cross the frozen moss
I walk with the wind
I stand with my antlers to the sky
I paw the snow for grass
My nose puffs white breath
My ears swivel both ways
I lower my head to graze lichen
I shake the snow off
I stand still by a tree
I rub my antlers on bark
You have stepped into the snow
My antlers point your way
My nose puffs white
You are coming too close
I turn my flank to guard
Where are your hands
I watch to see if you lunge

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，鹿角上还挂着雪。
lines.en: I lift my eyes to you, snow still clinging to my antlers.
I back up two steps
I toss my head hard
My ribs are aching
I paw the snow to hold
I lower my antlers to guard
I can butt once more

lines.zh: 被打了当然要还手，我低下头冲过去。
lines.en: Struck, I lower my head and charge back.

lines.zh: 雪地里退无可退，我只能顶回去。
lines.en: With no ground to give in the snow, I push back.
That is a red mushroom in your hand
I smell it, it is familiar
Hold the mushroom a little higher
I lower my head to eat it
After eating, I am much calmer
I will come a little closer still
You set the saddle down beside us
I chew the mushroom and watch you
If you gave me one more
My antler meets your shoulder
We kick up a spray of snow
My body pushes you aside
I slip once and hold
You hit my thick ribs
Snow mist rises where we meet
I lower my head and butt you
You back off, I stay put
My hooves skid on the ice
That was not yet a fight
My shoulder meets your body
We trample the snow flat
The does are just ahead
I follow the scent north
We walk side by side in the snow
Her antlers are shorter than mine
I touch her with my nose
The storm brings us together
We move with the herd
The calves will follow us
I take the wind for her

lines.zh: 雪地上的脚印成了两串
lines.en: Two trails of prints in the snow
I sniff at the ground
I turn the snow over with a hoof
I take up a tuft of moss
I chew it up
I pick up a red mushroom
This smell I know well
This does not smell like grass
I leave it be
I go back to hunting lichen
Something is nearing the herd
I raise my head and prick my ears
I turn my antlers that way
My hooves shifted back half a step.
My front hoof starts to paw
I have lowered my head
That smell worries me
There are calves, I will not move
I put my body in front
One step of yours, one of mine
My hooves pack the snow down
I will strike first
You have your back to the trees
My antlers are already low
I mean to hold this ground
I advance with my antlers low
You have given half a step
I swing to your front quarter
I keep pawing the ground
You have stepped into deep snow
I keep my footing better than you
Raise your hand and I charge
My breath clouds white
I have no line to give up here
My antlers aim at your flank
You cannot get past my antlers
The trees have cut off your retreat
I hear the ice under you crack
The snow hides your hands
My antlers stay low
I lift a front hoof
No one is coming to help you
I lower my head and hit your flank
My front hooves lash out
An antler tip opens your sleeve
I butt you twice in a row
I knock you into the snow
You are thrown backwards
My antler catches your armor
That one carried my whole weight
I ram your legs with my side
Snow flies up around us
I step back and charge again
An antler tip rakes your shoulder
You guard your chest, your flank is open
My head spins from the impact
I stamp and press forward
You block, and your hands go numb
I slam into your shield
I butt your leg
I kick your knee with a hoof
A line of prints appears in the snow
My antlers part the snow mist
The herd halts at the treeline
I find footing on thin ice
Snow melts on my back
I shake the snow off my back
A shadow joins the tundra
I come out of the pines
I blow out my first white breath
The woods go quiet for a moment
My prints land in the snow first
I come down the slope slowly
The wind frosts my antlers
Fire singes my coat
I slide a way across the ice
The blast throws me into the snow
Magic chills all four of my legs
The snow is too deep to find grass
The strike makes me jolt
I kick as I fall
